rules.name: No Personal Attacks
rules.description: Ad hominem attacks, insults, or demeaning personal remarks directed at other participants.

rules.name: No Poisoning the Well
rules.description: Preemptively dismissing or attacking an opponent's character or source before they can speak.

rules.name: No Hate Speech
rules.description: Any speech attacking, demeaning, or inciting violence against protected groups or individuals.

rules.name: Must Be 21 Years or Older to Participate on the Debate Panel
rules.description: Participant eligibility constraint for the panel.

rules.name: No Interrupting
rules.description: Speaking out of turn or interrupting another participant's designated speaking time.

rules.name: Stay On Topic
rules.description: Failing to address the debate topic or drifting into unrelated issues.

rules.name: Respect Speaking Time Limits
rules.description: Continuing to speak after the timer has run out or refusing to yield.

rules.name: Allow Others to Finish Speaking
rules.description: Failing to respect others' right to speak and complete their sentences.

rules.name: No Spam or Repeated Disruptions
rules.description: Continually making noises, repeating assertions, or flooding chat/audio channels.

rules.name: No Threats or Intimidation
rules.description: Using aggressive body language, direct threats of violence, or psychological pressure.

rules.name: Follow Host Instructions
rules.description: Refusing to comply with direct instructions or moderating decisions from the debate host.
